chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in Paisan pawikham nading ni guk a sap lai takin a sisa a thawhkiksakpa Lazaras omna Bethani khua-ah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin tuasan takah nitak an a vak uh hi. Martha in an a vak hi. Lazaras in Topa tawh an ne pawlte lakah a om hi.
Tua lai takin Mari in tampi a man mard paknamtui thawl khat la a, Zeisu’ khe nuhin a sam tawh a nul hi. Tua paknamtui in inn sung teng a zeel hi.
A nungzuite khat Zeisu lehheekpa Judas Iskariot in,
“Hih paknamtui dangka zathum tawh zuakin mizawngte bang hangin pia lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua bang a cih in mizawngte phattuamna ding ngaihsun hi lo hi; amah in gutapa hi a, dangka-ip tawi ahih ciangin, a sunga omsa teng sawk thei ahih hang hi.
Zeisu in, “Ka luang vui ding ni dongin amah in hih paknamtui koihkhol ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mizawngte in note tawh a omkhawm ngitnget uh hi. Kei ka hih leh, note tawh omkhawm ngitnget ding ka hi kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tuasan takah Zeisu a om Judah mite in a theih uh ciangin, amaute in Zeisu hang bek hi lo, a sisa a thawhkiksak Lazaras zong en dingin a hong pai uh hi.
Ahih hangin siampi liante in Lazaras zong thah dingin a vaihawm uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah hangin Judah mi tampite paikhia uh a, Zeisu a um uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin pawikhamna-ah a hong pai mite in, Jerusalem khua-ah Zeisu hong pai ding cih a thei uh hi.
Tua ciangin nisuh hiang tawi-in Topa dawn dingin a paikhia uh a, “Hosanna, Pasian’ min tawh hong pai Israel Kumpipa in, Thupha ngah ta hen!” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh bangin, Zeisu in lano khat ngah a, a tungah tuangin,
“Zion’ tanu aw, lau kei in; En in, na Kumpipa in, Lano tungah tuangin hong pai ding hi.” a ci hi.
Tua thute a cilin a nungzuite in a theih loh uh hangin, Zeisu in minthan’na a ngah khit ciangin Topa thu tua bangin kigelh a, ama tungah tua bangin a bawl ding hi a cihna thu a phawk uh hi.
Lazaras han sung pan samkhia a, sihna pan a thawhkiksak lai takin, Zeisu tawh a omkhawm mihonpite in teci a pang uh hi.
Tua theihsakna lim a bawlna mihonpite in a zak uh ciangin a dawn dingin a paikhia uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Farisaite in, “En un, bangmah na zo kei uh hi. Leitung mite khempeuh in ama nung a zui khin ta uh hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kici uh hi.
Pawikhamna sungah Pasian bia dinga hong paite lakah Grik mi zong a om uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuate in Galile gam Bethsaida khuami Filip kiangah va pai uh a, “Zeisu ka mu nuam uh hi, lawm aw,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Filip pai-a Andru va hilh hi. Andru leh Filip in a nih un Zeisu kiangah a ko uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Mihing Tapa in minthan’na a ngah hun hong tung zo hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, buhhum khat in lei tungah kia-a a sih kei leh, amah bek a om ding hi. Ahih hangin a sih leh, tampi a gah thei ding hi.
Ama nuntakna a itte in nuntakna a mangthangsak ding hi. Hih leitungah a nuntakna a mudahte in nuntak tawntungna a nei ding hi.
Ka na hong semte in ka nung hong zui ta hen. Keima omna munah ka nasemte zong a om ding hi. Ka na hong semte Pa in a pahtawi ding hi.”
“Tu-in ka lungmang a, bang ka gen ding hiam! Pa aw, hih hun pan hong gum in ka ci ding hiam? Hi lo hi, hih thu hangin hih hun kong tung zo hi.
Pa aw, na min na thangsak in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin, vantung pan aw khat ging a, “Ka thangsak zo a, khatvei ka thangsak kik ding hi,” a ci hi.
A kimkot a, ding mihonpite in hih thu a zak uh ciangin, “Van ging hi,’ a ci uh hi. Kimkhat in, “Vantungmi khat in amah tawh kiho hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Hih aw in kei ading hong pai ahi kei hi, note’ adinga hong pai ahi hi.
Tu-in hih leitung in thukhenna a thuak ding hi. Tu-in hih leitung ukpa kihawlkhia ding hi.
Keimah leitung pan hong kikhai ciangin mi khempeuh keima kiangah ka kai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bang a cih ciangin ama sihna ding lim a genna ahi hi.

Tua hi a, mihonpite in, “Khazih a om tawntung ding hi,’ ci-in Thukhamna sungah ka za zo uh hi. Tua bang ahih leh, ‘Mihing Tapa in kikhaina a thuak ding hi,’ bang hangin ci na hi hiam? Hih Mihing Tapa kua mi ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.

Tua ciangin Zeisu in, “Khuavakna in note kiangah tawlkhat a om lai ding hi. Khuamial in no hong lap loh nadingin khuavak a om lai takin na pai un. Khuamial lakah a pai mi in a tun’na ding a thei kei hi.”
“Khuavak in note tawh a omkhawm lai takin khuavak’ tate na suah nadingun khuavak na um un,” ci-in a gen hi. Tua thu teng Zeisu in a gen khit ciangin, paikhia-in a bu hi.
Tua zah nalamdang tampi amaute mai-ah a lah hangin, amau in a um kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Pasian’ kamsangpa Isaiah hilhna thu a tun’ nading hi. Tua thu in: “Topa aw, ka genna thu uh kua in hong um ahi hiam? Pasian’ khut kua kiangah kilang ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Khatvei Isaiah in a gen kikna thu in:

“A mit uh tawsakin, a lungsim uh a khauhsak hi. Tua bang hih kei leh, a mit uh tawh mu-in, A lungsim uh tawh thei ding uh a; Amau cinatna ka damsak ding hi,” a cihna thu hangin amaute in a um kei uh hi.
Isaiah in Zeisu’ minthan’na mu khol ahih ciangin tua bangin ama thu a genkhol hi.
Tua bang ahih hangin upa vaihawm tampite nangawn in Zeisu a up uh hangin, biakna innpi sung pan Farisaite in a hawlkhiat ding a lau manunah a kilangin a mang kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Pasian’ piak minthan’na sangin mite piak minthan’na a deih zaw uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Kei hong um mi in kei bek hong um kei hi.
Kei hong sawlpa zong a um hi. Kei hong mu mi in kei hong sawlpa zong a mu hi.
Kei hong um mi in khuamial lakah a om loh nadingin kei khuavakin leitungah kong pai hi.
Ka thu za a, a zui lo mi ke’n thu ka khen kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leitung mite thu khen dingin hong pai ka hi kei hi. Leitung mite gum dingin hong pai ka hi hi.
Kei hong nolh a, ka thu a ngai lo mi in thukhen ding mi khat a nei hi. Ka hilhna thu in ni tawp Ni ciangin tua mi tungah thu a khen ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka ut bangin ka gen kei hi, kei hong sawl Pa kiang panin bangci gen ding, bangci hilh ding ci-in thupiakna ka ngah hi.
Ama hong thupiakna in nuntak tawntungna ahi hi ci-in ka thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka hilhna teng Pa in keima kiangah hong piak bangin a hilh ka hi hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
